subject: Re: Derivative filtering & provenance registry — Axion Health evidence request
messages:
From: Sana Rao <sana@axionhealth.com>
To: olga_petrov <olga@redwood.com>
Cc: Maya Singh <maya.singh@axionhealth.com>, Alex Brooks <alex.brooks@axionhealth.com>
Date: 2027-10-03T09:12:00Z
Subject: Derivative filtering & provenance registry — evidence request

Hi Olga,

Thanks again for the demo last week. As we evaluate Redwood for our patient-facing summarization pipeline we have two compliance asks from legal and security:

1) A clear operational description of how you prevent tenant prompts/responses from being used to improve any models (no-training/no-learning commitment), and what evidence you can provide (logs, configuration snapshots, attestations).
2) Whether you can maintain a provenance registry that binds incoming prompts to response metadata and exportable artifacts (for export / audit) without including prompt text in long-term stores — we need a way to map responses back to request IDs and retention state.

Our timeline is tight: legal wants an evidence package and a short runbook by 2027-10-10. Can you confirm feasibility and a realistic delivery plan?

Thanks,
Sana
Director, Product Security
Axion Health

Attachments: axion-data-map.csv (referenced in body)

From: olga_petrov <olga@redwood.com>
To: Sana Rao <sana@axionhealth.com>
Cc: Maya Singh <maya.singh@axionhealth.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-10-03T12:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Derivative filtering & provenance registry — evidence request

Sana — thanks for outlining the ask and the deadline. We can meet your requirements; below is a concise plan and what we'll deliver by 2027-10-08 to give you time for review before the 10th.

Summary of commitments:
- No-training: We'll provide a signed operational attestation that tenant traffic to Axion's workspace is disabled from model-improvement pipelines (controls at the routing and ingest layers). This will be accompanied by a config snapshot and a short video (ops walkthrough) showing the toggle.
- Provenance registry: We propose providing an exportable registry that includes: request ID, model/version served, timestamp, KV-cache pointers (opaque), response checksum (SHA256), retention state, and routing tier. We will not include customer prompt text in the long-term registry exports — prompts will be retained in ephemeral stores only while they are required for live session continuity.

Deliverables (target 2027-10-08):
1) Evidence pack: config snapshots, audit-log slices (30 days), short ops walkthrough, and the requested checklist PDF.
2) Runbook: steps to verify and reproduce the no-training toggle and to query the provenance registry for an export.
3) Export example: a sanitized CSV that maps Axion request IDs to response checksums and retention flags.

Action items for internal team:
- Dev: produce the audit-log slice and the export example.
- Aditya: prepare the attestation language and legal-facing note about exportability and IP.
- Stephanie: review for contract redlines around the no-training commitment and help estimate any legal risk.

Sana — one question: do you need the registry to include ephemeral prompt hash markers (to prove prompt existed without disclosing text)? If yes, we'll include a salted hash column in the export.

Olga Petrov
Head of Privacy & Policy, Redwood Inference
olga@redwood.com

---
Forwarded attachment stubs: axion-data-map.csv (see original email)

From: Dev Patel <dev@redwood.com>
To: olga_petrov <olga@redwood.com>, Sana Rao <sana@axionhealth.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-10-04T10:34:00Z
Subject: Re: Derivative filtering & provenance registry — audit slices and export prototype

On Mon, Oct 3, 2027 at 12:05 PM olga_petrov <olga@redwood.com> wrote:
> Sana — thanks for outlining the ask and the deadline. We can meet your requirements...

Working notes and what's attached:
- Attached: requested-evidence-checklist.pdf (checklist of items we're assembling).
- Attached: audit-log-sample.csv (slice of events; timestamps, request_id, route, model, action).

Technical approach (short):
1) No-training enforcement: requests from Axion's tenant are tagged with a tenant-level flag (no_learn=true) at the edge. The processing pipeline discards that flag before any training telemetry export paths. We also maintain a denylist in the model-improve kafka topics; the consumer filters at ingestion.
2) Provenance registry export: we'll build a sanitized export pipeline: request_id, response_sha256, model_id, model_version, retention_flag, timestamp, salted_prompt_hash (optional). Prompt text will only exist in ephemeral Redis-like session stores (TTL 1 hour by default) and an ops-only S3 lifecycle policy that deletes after 30 days unless retention is requested.
3) Evidence: we'll provide a filtered Splunk/ELK export (audit-log-sample.csv) plus a runbook script that reproduces the export query; ops will include screenshots.

Known gaps:
- We do not currently have customer-facing UI to run exports; it's an ops-only endpoint. We can provide an on-demand export workflow or build a limited UI for Axion as part of the onboarding scope.

Next steps (internal):
- Aditya: attach the draft attestation.
- Stephanie: confirm whether the attestation wording needs to be in the DPA or can remain a separate operations attestation.

Dev Patel
Principal Software Engineer, Inference Ops
Dev@redwood.com

Attachments (stubs): requested-evidence-checklist.pdf, audit-log-sample.csv

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.com>
To: Sana Rao <sana@axionhealth.com>, olga_petrov <olga@redwood.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-10-05T17:22:00Z
Subject: Re: Derivative filtering & provenance registry — contract note and timeline

Sana / team,

Appreciate the clarity on scope — quick legal note and timeline:
- We can include a no-training operational attestation (ops-level commitment) and an explicit DPA addendum clause that states: "Redwood shall not use Customer Data for model training or model improvement outside the explicit, documented opt-in processes for this Customer." We will avoid "forever" promises; instead we will provide the attestation and ongoing operational evidence windows (30/90 days).
- If Axion requires contractual "no-train" as a permanent covenant, that needs to be reflected as a DPA amendment (we can draft). Otherwise we propose the attestation + quarterly audit exports as the technical control.

Timeline:
- 2027-10-06: Aditya to share draft attestation and suggested DPA language.
- 2027-10-08: Ops bundle (export example, audit slices, runbook) delivered to Axion.
- 2027-10-12: If DPA amendment requested, legal will circulate redlines and we can target signature within two weeks after that.

For now, I'll attach a redline stub for the DPA language and the list of audit evidences we'll provide. If Axion wants salted prompt hashes included in the first export, confirm by EOD 2027-10-06.

Steph Nguyen
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
stephanie@redwood.com
